subject: Short-term QPS top-up and granular invoice repair
messages:
From: Jesse Lang <jesse.lang@healthbridge.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthBridge Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: temporary QPS uplift + invoice adjustment for April spike

Hi Rohan,

Quick background: we experienced a sudden integration loop on April 12 that caused a spike in API requests during our pilot cutover. We throttled quickly on our side but the traffic made it through for ~6 hours and we saw a material overage on the April invoice. We opened a ticket with your Support team (ticket #3456) and included traces — attaching the logs and the support ticket PDF to this message.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provision a short-term QPS uplift (targeting +450 QPS) for our next launch window (7 days) so we don't get throttled while we validate fixes? Ideal start is tomorrow, 04/16.
- Can your billing team review the April overage invoice and consider a pro-rated adjustment or credit while the root cause is investigated? We believe at least part of this spike is attributable to the integration loop. Invoice reference: HB-INV-0426-1192 (attached in the procurement thread).

We appreciate quick turnaround — the launch schedule is tight and procurement needs a clear path.

Thanks,
Jesse Lang
Head of Platform Integrations
HealthBridge AI

Attachments: traffic_logs.csv (CSV), support_ticket_3456.pdf (PDF)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Jesse Lang <jesse.lang@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary QPS uplift + invoice adjustment for April spike

Jesse — thanks for the details and for sending the logs. I reviewed the support ticket and flagged it to SRE; they confirm seeing the anomalous retry pattern you described.

Short answer: we can get you a temporary QPS bridge and we can pause billing collection for the disputed portion while we investigate. Proposed next steps from our side:
- Temporary uplift: provision a 7-day bridge to 750 QPS (your baseline is 300). We can start this tomorrow morning UTC.
- Pricing for uplift: we typically apply our surge rate for short windows, but given the integration failure and your pilot status I'm proposing a blended uplift price (see attached proposed_quote_RI-472.pdf) — essentially surge rate discounted by 20% for the 7-day window.
- Invoice adjustment: we will ask Billing to hold on the overage line for HB-INV-0426-1192 while SRE completes RCA. If SRE verifies it was caused by transient integration retries we will apply a one-time credit (amount to be determined; see Marissa's note below).

Please confirm you accept the temporary uplift and the proposed pricing. If yes, I'll route to Provisioning to flip the switch and to Billing to place the invoice on hold.

On the attachments: I included a draft quote outlining the uplift, discount, and proposed credit framework.

—
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Attachment: proposed_quote_RI-472.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 19:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary QPS uplift + invoice adjustment for April spike

Looping in Brian from CS separately for technical validation, but here is the commercial position I recommend so we can move quickly:

Commercial proposal (for internal approval):
- Provision 7-day uplift to 750 QPS starting 2026-04-16 00:00 UTC.
- Apply a 20% discount to our published short-window surge rate for that 7-day period (blended surcharge in the draft quote).
- Place invoice HB-INV-0426-1192 on hold pending SRE RCA (target 72 hours).
- If SRE confirms the spike was caused by a misbehaving HealthBridge integration, grant a one-time credit of $2,000 against the overage line. If RCA shows a product misconfiguration on our end, escalate to legal for settlement.

Info we need from HealthBridge to finalize:
- Formal acceptance of the uplift and pricing (email reply is fine).
- Confirmed invoice number (Jesse included HB-INV-0426-1192).
- HubSpot deal tag / procurement PO (add to the quote for audit).

If approved internally, Ben — can you confirm accounting can hold the invoice and redact it from automated collections? Laura — flag if this needs an approval path or credit committee review given dollar sign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Quoted items: uplift 750 QPS (7 days), blended surge rate (-20%), one-time credit $2,000
Related links: https://hubspot.example/com/deal/HB-2026-04-PILOT-17
Attachment: (internal) proposed_quote_RI-472.pdf

From: Jesse Lang <jesse.lang@healthbridge.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthBridge Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 22:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary QPS uplift + invoice adjustment for April spike

Thanks — we accept the 7-day uplift to 750 QPS with the 20% blended surge discount and appreciate the hold on invoice HB-INV-0426-1192 while you run RCA. We also accept the preliminary one-time credit framework; final credit amount contingent on SRE confirmation, which is fine.

For your records:
- Procurement PO: HB-PO-3321 (attached to procurement thread).
- Invoice: HB-INV-0426-1192
- HubSpot deal: HB-2026-04-PILOT-17

Please advise the exact UTC start time for the uplift and confirm when Billing has placed the invoice on hold. If you need anything from our side (additional traces or logs) ping me or the procurement inbox.

Appreciate the quick coordination — this keeps our launch on track.

Best,
Jesse Lang
Head of Platform Integrations
HealthBridge AI
